family: Chosen creatures and next-turn attack restriction

cases.name: Oracle en-Vec
cases.text: {T}: Target opponent chooses any number of creatures they control. During that player's next turn, the chosen creatures attack if able, and other creatures can't attack. At the beginning of that turn's end step, destroy each of the chosen creatures that didn't attack this turn. Activate only during your turn.

cases.name: Oracle en-Vec
